extracted.name: Teriyaki Sauce and Marinade
extracted.description: This traditional Japanese teriyaki sauce recipe just might be the best you've ever had!
instruction_lines: Bring mirin to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer for 10 minutes. Pour in soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and sugar. Season with garlic, ginger, pepper flakes, and black pepper; simmer an additional 5 minutes. Store in a tightly sealed container in the refrigerator.
